view.detail: The filing tags the same concept twice in the same context with different values: http://fasb.org/us-gaap/2025#TreasuryStockCommonShares@c-58/shares = 1353666394 / 1354000000; http://fasb.org/us-gaap/2025#TreasuryStockCommonShares@c-59/shares = 1352874243 / 1353000000; http://fasb.org/us-gaap/2025#EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperations@c-57/number = 0.14 / 0.135. The filing contradicts itself and no figure from it can be trusted.
